## Nendoroid 

The Nendoroid figure line from Good Smile Company brings your favorite characters to life in an adorable, chibi style. Each Nendoroid is a highly detailed, posable figure that includes interchangeable face plates and accessories, allowing you to recreate iconic scenes or customize your display. With over 2,000 characters from popular anime, manga, video games, and movies, the Nendoroid collection has something for every fan and collector. Discover new ways to collect with Nendoroid Doll, Nendoroid More, Nendoroid Surprise and more!

### Nendoroid More: Robobot Armor Reissue

Unlike every other figure in this guide, the Robobot Armor comes in two variants: the standard edition and a package that does not include a Nendoroid Kirby. Before you make a purchase though, please be aware that the expression and goggles included with the Nendoroid Kirby in the standard Robobot Armor bundle are exclusive to that product and cannot be purchased separately. Once again, if you purchase an original Nendoroid Kirby, that figure DOES NOT come with the variant accessories included with the Robobot Armor.

- Exchanges or returns are not accepted once the product is received.
- Some products may not be eligible for the campaign even if they are made available for preorder during the campaign period. Thank you for your understanding.
- The bonuses may be used for other campaigns.

results.title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice Nendoroid Figures Available To Preorder At Amazon - GameSpot
results.author: Darryn Bonthuys
highlights:
Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice Nendoroid Figures Available To Preorder At Amazon - GameSpot

...

A sequel to Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice doesn’t seem likely, but at least you can make your own follow-up to the brilliant From Software action game with a pair of cute Nendoroid figures. Available to preorder now at Amazon, these two figures of Wolf ($46) and Genichiro Ashina ($52) will begin shipping out May 2025.

- Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice Wolf Nendoroid— $46 | May 14, 2025
- Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice Genichiro Ashina Nendoroid— $52 | May 14, 2025

...

There are quite a few other Nendoroid figures available to preorder now, each one boasting a similar level of screen-accurate design and pocket-sized cuteness. If you’re looking to build a collection of gaming Nendoroids, you can check out the Elden Ring and Metal Gear Solid figures.
